channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Opposition offers alternatives to food consumption tax cut in parliamentary debate
item.description: Having made the policy central to her economic agenda, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi faces a test of whether she can create tangible household relief.

item.title: Chinese AI tool used in cyberattacks on Japanese companies, investigation finds
item.description: The threat of cyberattacks for Japanese companies has grown recently, as the number of companies disclosing data breaches continues to rise.

item.title: Politics of the potato front and center for Japan’s new agriculture minister
item.description: Arata Takebe's Hokkaido constituents might oppose a push to increase potato imports from the U.S.

item.title: Under pledge to U.S., Japan’s chip investment divided between home and abroad
item.description: The $550 billion commitment to the Trump administration, in return for lower tariffs, won't do much to resurrect Japan's chip industry, experts say.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
